title: El legado neoliberal
goal: Read a closing, balanced assessment of the neoliberal decade -- the hyperinflation-taming success of Argentina's 1991 Convertibility Plan and Brazil's 1994 Plano Real, against the structural fragility that contributed to Argentina's 2001 collapse.

items: State the achievement defenders of the model point to.
Explain what Argentina's 1991 Convertibility Plan did.
Explain what critics say about the fixed exchange rate's rigidity.
Summarize the "paradox" many analysts see in the neoliberal legacy.
Use dicho de otro modo to rephrase an idea for clarity.
